title: Mission: The Electric Tractor
subtitle: Build the electric tractor and work the farm.
summary: Meet the electric tractor, learn its parts, and pull the plow across the field.
activityLabel: Pull the trailer to the field
activityInstruction: Drive the electric tractor and pull the vegetable trailer across the field.

storyQuestions.prompt: Who is working on the farm?
storyQuestions.success: A farmer is working on the farm.

storyQuestions.prompt: What does the farmer need to do?
storyQuestions.success: The farmer needs to move the trailer.

storyQuestions.prompt: What does the farmer try to do?
storyQuestions.success: The farmer tries to pull the trailer.
No, the farmer cannot move it.
It is too heavy, so he cannot move it.

answers: A strong machine to help pull it
storyQuestions.success: He needs a strong machine to help pull it.

quiz.prompt: Which part stores the power for the tractor?
Which part turns electricity into movement?
quiz.success: The motor turns electricity into movement.

quiz.prompt: Which part digs into the soil?
quiz.success: The plow digs into the soil.

quiz.prompt: Which part grips the soil so the tractor can pull?
quiz.success: The big wheels grip the soil.

parts.label: Cab
parts.fact: The cab is the little room where the farmer sits to steer the tractor.
parts.help: The windowed box on top of the tractor.

parts.label: Wheels
parts.fact: The big wheels grip the soft soil so the tractor can pull heavy loads.
parts.help: The two round wheels under the body.

parts.label: Trailer
parts.fact: The trailer carries heavy vegetables and tools behind the tractor.
parts.help: Look for the large cart behind the tractor.

parts.label: Hitch
parts.fact: The hitch is the strong connector that lets the tractor pull the trailer.
parts.help: Look for the small link between the tractor and the trailer.
